# Sobermark

> Sobermark is a private sobriety tracker app for Android and iPhone. It counts sober days, money saved and drinks skipped, gives you a press-and-hold craving button and a 10 minute ride-it-out timer for hard moments, and marks milestones with Bern, a blue bear companion. No account, no sign-up: everything stays on your phone.

Made by Digital Highrise Ltd (London, UK). Works for quitting alcohol, smoking, vaping, cannabis and gambling, or a custom habit.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Android (Google Play, package app.sobermark) and iPhone (App Store id6802116915)
- Price: free core (day counter, craving button, ride-it-out timer, daily check-in). Sobermark Pro adds full stats, the full journal, badges and share cards, with a 3 day free trial then a yearly or weekly plan.
- Privacy: no account, no social feed, data stored on the device only. Reset or erase any time.
- If you slip: reset your date and keep going; your best streak stays on the record.
- Not a medical device. Heavy drinkers should speak to a doctor before stopping suddenly.
